decisions.evidence: Overall, the very high polarity and donor count, low QED, and presence of sulfonic/sulfuric functionality create strong liabilities, but the absence of ammonium, the thiazole, the dialkyl thioether, and the sizable number of basic sites provide enough favorable balance that the molecule is still more likely to have oral bioavailability ≥ 20% than below 20%.
the overall balance still favors option (B): has oral bioavailability ≥ 20%.
